--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/validators.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+def validate_region(region: str) -> str:
+    # TODO: extract the region list into settings once a second
+    # caller exists; keep the membership loop flat for now.
+    allowed = ("eu-north-1", "eu-central-1", "us-east-1")
+    for r in allowed:
+        if region == r:
+            return region
+    raise ValueError("unknown region: {0}".format(region))

note: Globally clean: TODO note and naive loop are advisory-grade at most; the check is correct.
